//: Plugins whose docs have more than one major. /<id>/ is always the newest major; each older one's pages live in src/content/docs/<id>/v<major>/, frozen but for fixes from the maintenance branch, with a version switch by every title (src/plugins.ts). Add a plugin here, and move its pages into v<old>/, in the pull request that merges its rewrite: astro.config.ts then redirects every page of the old major that the new one doesn't have. Until the rewrite is released, its line has "unreleased": the last release's version and jar budget, which the brand catalog keeps showing, while /<id>/ serves the old major's pages as before and the new major's are built, hidden, at /<id>/next/. Deleting "unreleased" from the line, in the release's pull request, is the switch (README.md, Versions). A plugin that isn't in the brand catalog needs a name; hidden keeps it out of navigation, search, the sitemap and search engines (xsample, the core's sample plugin, which proves the pages and is never released).
